name: Calling Panther Lake

fees.note: $25 a night (21 sites (and 2 accessible ones) with electric, water and sewer). Campers 62 and older and disabled campers $15. MDWFP's state fishing lake fees (rate sheet effective 2023-06-23), read 2026-10-12.
